## Context / Problem
Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

`_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES={}`/`_map_legacy_env`/`_ALIASES={}` are empty since ADR 0116 yet still threaded through five modules (Aliases below). 13 warn-class tombstones (7 env rows `src/rebar/_deprecations.py:209-217` + 6 cfg rows `:226,227,231,236,240,241`) are inert and all claim `removed_in="v1.0.0"` (`_tomb` at `:196-199` hardcodes `_MAJOR`). `[llm]` is reserved (`_config_sections.py:209`, `continue` at `:224`), so `[llm] overlap_k = 5` is silently accepted even under `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error`; the overlap epic needs removed `overlap_*` keys to warn. The alias loop (`:244-250`, -3 McCabe) and the `[llm]` branch land together because `coerce_sparse` sits at the McCabe-15 ceiling. Removed env names never warn - `env_overrides()` (`_config_sources.py:342-352`) reads only live `_SECTIONS` keys, so a still-set `REBAR_PUSH` is ignored silently; only cfg keys reach `_warn_unknown`.

## Approach
Mechanics are itemised in this ticket's first comment (the description carries the decisions).

**Aliases.** Delete `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:330-339`; `src/rebar/config.py:9,45,56` imports and `:382-385`; `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:32`; `src/rebar/_config_sections.py:196-198,244-250` (`:243` -> `warn_deprecated_cfg_keys(sect, d, logger=logger)`; drop the unused `warn_deprecated` import `:22`); `src/rebar/_commands/show_config.py:142-146`. `scripts/gen_env_registry.py:484-488`: rewrite the comment to cite `rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY`; attribution string becomes `"src/rebar/_deprecations.py (deprecation registry)"` (no output change). Keep `REGISTRY`/`warn_deprecated`/`warn_deprecated_cfg_keys` (the future deprecation channel).

**Tombstones.** `_tomb(kind, name, replacement, behavior, *, removed_in: str)` - keyword-required, no `_MAJOR` default (`_MAJOR` stays for `_scheduled`, `:62`). The registry becomes exactly six error rows: `env TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR`, `env REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_RECONCILE_LIVE`, `cfg verify.require_verdict_for_close`, `file .rebar/config.conf`, `env REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS` at `removed_in="v0.8.0"`; `env REBAR_LLM_MODEL` at `removed_in="v0.12.0"`. `warn` stays vocabulary (`_TOMBSTONE_BEHAVIORS`, pinned by `test_tombstone_registry.py:71`); templates unchanged (`show_config.py:180,182`, `_deprecations.py:186-193,280`).

**`[llm]` warn.** In `_config_sections.py` add `_LLM_KNOWN_KEYS: tuple[str, ...]` next to `_RESERVED_SECTIONS` (`:209`): the 15 keys read in `config_readers.py`, `llm/config.py`, `llm/headers.py`, `llm/model_classes.py`, plus `evals` (eval-harness epic). Replace `:223-224`: for `sect == "llm"` with a dict value, `_warn_unknown("llm", <keys not in _LLM_KNOWN_KEYS>, source, strict=strict)`, then `continue`. No `rebar.llm` import (docstring `:200-204` rule). Messages are the existing `_config_coercion.py:88` templates with `llm.<key>` as the key.

**Sync test** `tests/unit/test_config_llm_known_keys.py::test_llm_known_keys_match_config_readers`: AST-walk `config_readers.py` for every `_llm_str/_llm_int/_llm_float/_llm_str_source` call (4th positional string literal) and `llm/config.py`, `llm/headers.py`, `llm/model_classes.py` for `table.get("<lit>")`; assert `set(_LLM_KNOWN_KEYS) - {"evals"} == collected` and `"evals" in _LLM_KNOWN_KEYS` (the eval epic deletes the carve-out with its reader). Equality is exact, so this story depends on the overlap epic's `overlap_*` removal story (`granitic-realisable-dolphin`, `09a8-5436-6b65-479c`); before it the tuple (operator ruling: exclude the 13 keys) would false-warn.

**Docs.** `docs/api-stability.md:27` (alias sentence -> registry sentence; keep `:30-34`); `docs/config.md:862-902` (Back-compat: policy default `warn` unchanged per `_config_sources.py:357-363`, `[llm]` warns; no alias tables; `:886-902` -> six error rows with releases + no-warn-tombstones sentence) and `:410-413` (`[llm]` warns like a core section); `scripts/gen_config_reference.py:224-233,342-346` (`Removed in` column) + regenerate `docs/config-reference.md`; `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py:255-267` asserts `tomb.removed_in in row`; `tests/golden/config_surface.json` unchanged (no tombstoned name is in it).

**Tests.** Delete the alias/tombstone assertions in the six existing test files in Scope. Add `test_tombstone_registry.py::test_every_tombstone_names_its_real_removal_release` (each row matches `^v0\.\d+\.\d+$`, none is `v1.0.0`) and `::test_only_error_class_rows_remain`; `test_config_backcompat.py::test_unknown_llm_key_warns_like_a_core_key` (caplog has `unknown key 'llm.bogus'`), `::test_unknown_llm_key_errors_under_strict`, `::test_known_llm_key_never_warns` (`[llm] model = "x"` -> no warning).

**Release note** (`docs/release-notes.md` + `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`), one BREAKING (pre-1.0) entry: 13 warn-class tombstones retired - 7 env names no longer read (no warning), 6 cfg keys ordinary unknown keys, six error rows report their removal release, unknown `[tool.rebar.llm]` keys warn.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_config_sources.py`, `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`, `src/rebar/_config_schema.py`, `src/rebar/config.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/show_config.py`, `src/rebar/_deprecations.py`, `scripts/gen_env_registry.py`, `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/config-reference.md`, `docs/api-stability.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; tests `tests/unit/test_config_alias_overlap_rename.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_show.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_backcompat.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_resolved_statuses_removal.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_tombstone_registry.py`, `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py`, new `tests/unit/test_config_llm_known_keys.py`. `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS` default stays `warn` - no change. Out of scope: `src/rebar/llm/config.py:47,55,114-143,408-426,505,521`, `_config_schema.py:81-84`, the `overlap_*` keys in `config_readers.py:211-316` (overlap epic); `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` (reconciler epic); the `[llm.evals]` reader (eval-harness epic).

## Testing
- `printf '[llm]\noverlap_k = 5\n' > rebar.toml`: `rebar config validate` -> exit 0 (skips reserved sections, `show_config.py:129`); `rebar list` logs `unknown key 'llm.overlap_k' ignored`; `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error rebar list` -> exit != 0 naming `llm.overlap_k`.
- `TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=x rebar list` -> non-zero, stderr names `v0.8.0` and `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`; `TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=x rebar config validate` prints `ERROR: env TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR was removed in v0.8.0...`; `REBAR_LLM_MODEL=x rebar review-plan <id> --status` -> error naming `v0.12.0`.
- `printf '[code_health]\nenabled = true\n' > rebar.toml; rebar list` -> exit 0, log `unknown key 'code_health.enabled' ignored`; `REBAR_PUSH=off rebar list` -> exit 0, silent.
- `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`, `ruff check --select C901 src/rebar/_config_sections.py` (coerce_sparse <= 13), `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC1 `git grep -n '_ALIASES\b\|_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES\|_map_legacy_env' -- src tests scripts` empty (verified by the grep).
- [ ] AC2 `tombstones()` has exactly 6 rows, all `behavior=="error"`, `removed_in in {v0.8.0 x5, v0.12.0}` (two new `test_tombstone_registry.py` tests).
- [ ] AC3 The three CLI commands above produce the quoted text (interfaces tests; `test_error_env_var_fails_loud:124` asserts `removed_in in out`).
- [ ] AC4 Unknown `[llm]` key warns/errors per policy, known keys never warn (three new `test_config_backcompat.py` tests); the sync test is green.
- [ ] AC5 `gen_config_reference.py --check` and `generate_config_surface_golden.py --check` clean; `make verify` green.
